rule_2026_11_15: Michael 2026-11-15: a declaration covers ONE change. It carries deleted_sha256, the sha256 of the lines that change deletes from the file (scripts/deletions_declared.py ANCHOR --digest PATH); a path may hold a list of declarations, one per change. A declaration without the digest, or with another one, covers nothing: the path-only entries below were kept for history and no longer cover any new deletion.
